claims.text: Comprehensive exploration of the intricate relationship between AIGC and communication networks is relatively limited in existing literature.
LLMs and AIGC technologies can be integrated within the domain of communication networks.
Communication networks can bolster the capabilities of LLMs and AIGC technologies.

evidence.description: The authors note that although noteworthy advancements have been made, a comprehensive exploration of the relationship between AIGC and communication networks remains relatively limited.
The article scrutinizes the integration of LLMs and AIGC technologies within the domain of communication networks.
The survey investigates how communication networks can further bolster the capabilities of LLMs and AIGC.

methodologies.name: Dual-standpoint literature survey
methodologies.description: A comprehensive survey analyzing both the integration of AIGC/LLMs into communication networks and how communication networks enhance AIGC/LLMs.

limitations.text: A comprehensive exploration of the intricate relationship between AIGC and communication networks remains relatively limited.
